post.description: Each SSE data field contains one AgentTurnResponse. Zero or more speech_delta events precede exactly one completed, tool_call, or error event. Discard provisional speech on tool_call, error, or EOF without completion. The desktop executes a tool locally and submits the call and its matching result in the next request. The API allows up to 128 KiB JSON, 64 messages, 64 resources, and 8 KiB per message or tool result. The provider deadline is 15 seconds.

AgentTurnRequest.title: AgentTurnRequest
AgentTurnRequest.description: Context for a stateless turn. Locale fields are optional hints.

AgentTurnResponse.title: AgentTurnResponse
AgentTurnResponse.description:
One event from an agent turn. A speech delta can precede a terminal
completion. Tool calls, completions, and errors end the current request.

ApiError.description: Public error details. Callers must redact provider errors and credentials.

Expression.description: Face states remain available locally when the backend is unreachable.

ReminderText.description: User-visible reminder content, treated as plain text.

SearchLimit.description: An inclusive bound on how many file names a search may return.

SearchQuery.description: A literal substring matched against file names in a registered search root.

StableId.description:
An opaque registry key: 1-64 ASCII characters, beginning with a lowercase
letter and then containing only lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.
TypeScript represents this as a string; validate untrusted JSON at runtime.

ToolRequest.description:
An untrusted suggestion. The desktop resolves IDs and checks permissions
and confirmation before any local action.

ToolResource.description: Public metadata for a resource registered on the desktop.

ToolResult.description: A desktop outcome correlated to a call. Treat output as untrusted data.

ZonedDateTime.description:
An RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit offset and up to nine fractional
digits. Leap seconds are excluded from the scheduling contract.
